_README.title: S&P 100 Growth Metrics
_README.description: Financial growth metrics extracted from SEC EDGAR filings for S&P 100 companies
_README.purpose: Track revenue and EPS growth for the largest US companies

sector.description: GICS sector classification for the company

annual_values.description: Actual annual revenue and EPS values for each fiscal year

fields.eps: Annual diluted EPS in USD per share

quarterly_values.description: Actual quarterly revenue and EPS values

fields.eps: Quarterly diluted EPS in USD per share

ttm.description: Trailing Twelve Months metrics from the most recent 4 quarters

fields.revenue: Sum of revenue from the last 4 quarters (USD)
fields.eps_diluted: Sum of diluted EPS from the last 4 quarters
fields.revenue_yoy: TTM revenue growth vs prior TTM
fields.eps_yoy: TTM EPS growth vs prior TTM

concept_sources.fallback:yfinance: Yahoo Finance annual data via yfinance

trading_applications.growth_screening: Filter companies by revenue/EPS growth rates
trading_applications.valuation_context: Compare growth rates to P/E ratios

notes: All growth rates are decimals (multiply by 100 for percentage)
Null values indicate insufficient data from all sources
Revenue figures are in USD (not scaled)
Fiscal year end dates vary by company
revenue_concept and eps_concept fields indicate data source

metadata.data_sources: SEC EDGAR + yfinance + Alpha Vantage + Finnhub
